summary: Derek Nunner, 23, of Telluride was injured backcountry skiing the San Joaquin chute in upper Bear Creek; struck a rock roughly one-third down the couloir and tumbled the remaining two-thirds; SAR members skied in and a Helitrax helicopter flew the patient to Telluride Airport, then EMS transport to Telluride Medical Center with non-life-threatening injuries.
location: San Joaquin chute, upper Bear Creek, Telluride
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff Search and Rescue; Helitrax helicopter; Telluride EMS
